title: 刚刚，多模态版DeepSeek“长眼”了，1000张图只要1块钱
content: DeepSeek launched its first multimodal API model, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, which processes images at up to 384 tokens each with no extra cost beyond standard text pricing. The model outperforms its text-only predecessor in six of seven agent benchmarks and rivals top Silicon Valley models on vision tasks. At roughly ¥1.15 per 1,000 images (under ¥0.60 during off-peak hours), it costs 25-50× less than competitors. The release completes DeepSeek's agent infrastructure stack, enabling developers to build vision-capable applications without integrating separate models.

title: Microsoft's Deputy CISO on Securing AI Agents
content: Aaron Zollman, Deputy CISO at Microsoft Gaming, discusses securing AI agents in enterprises. Microsoft initially considered banning OpenClaw but instead developed safe usage frameworks. Key topics include identity management, permissions, containerization, and monitoring for agent deployments. AI is transforming the CISO role from blocking technology to enabling secure adoption. The conversation also covers AI's potential to accelerate vulnerability patching and emphasizes that new AI threats coexist with existing security challenges rather than replacing them.

title: 基站变算力节点，恒湾科技完成B+轮融资
content: Chinese firm Hengwan Technology completed B+ round financing led by Shenzhen Capital Group, with Guokai Technology Innovation and Wofu Venture Capital participating. The Chengdu-based RF technology company, founded in 2019, will use funds for core chip development, AI-RAN and 6G research, and overseas expansion. Hengwan has achieved commercial revenue in AI-RAN and 6G, with over 100 intellectual property rights including 43 invention patents. The company has R&D centers in Xi'an and Beijing, plus operations in Singapore, Ireland, Malaysia, and Vietnam, serving major international clients in Europe, America, Japan, and South Korea. Investors cited the industry shift toward software-defined, AI-native programmable computing platforms and edge computing infrastructure as key rationales.

content: OpenAI open-sourced Codex Harness, the core framework powering its AI agents, under Apache-2.0 license. Harness manages task execution, memory, tool calling, human approvals, and error handling—enabling developers to embed AI directly into existing business applications rather than forcing workflows into generic chat interfaces. OpenAI demonstrated that optimized harness design improved GPT-5.6's ARC-AGI-3 score from 13.3% to 38.3% while reducing token output sixfold. The release includes three components: CLI tool codex exec, official SDKs for TypeScript/Python, and Codex app-server for product integration. Early adopters include Thrive Holdings (tax preparation, 7,000 filings processed, ~33% time reduction) and Cisco (cloud platform app builder).

title: 零基础速通DeepSeek Harness，带你玩转赛博乐高
content: DeepSeek Harness is an AI agent framework requiring command-line installation. Users can install it via source code, Node.js quick-start, third-party desktop apps, or by delegating to other AI agents like Codex or WorkBuddy. It features workspace-based project management, multi-turn task execution with approval checkpoints, and a "trajectory" page showing tool calls and token usage. Its plugin system, powered by the Cordis kernel, allows extensive UI customization and functional extensions. A recent update added multimodal input support to commands like /goal and /plan, though actual image processing depends on the underlying model's capabilities. Launching the article's featured UI plugin required approximately 15 minutes using brute-force prompt Iteration. Uninstallation varies by installation method but can also be delegated to AI agents.

content: Unitree founder Wang Xingxing stated at the 2026 World Robot Congress that the main barrier to universal robots entering daily life is insufficient embodied intelligence generalization. title: 做了个自用的 ACP Agent 桌面客户端，更新快半年了，拉出来见见世面
content: Fello is an open-source ACP Agent desktop client developed over six months. It integrates chat, file tree, terminal, and diff functionality. Users can connect to external ACP agents (with optimizations for CodeBuddy, Kiro, and Kimi-cli) or use built-in OpenAI-compatible API support. Additional features include WeChat integration, WebUI, cron scheduling, and persistent project memory. Data remains local by default. The creator built it to avoid vendor lock-in and unify multiple AI tools after finding existing solutions lacking.

title: 我国首个相关客服国标 9 月出手规范：整治 AI 客服答非所问、找不到人工客服
content: China's first national standard governing the coordination between human and AI customer service takes effect September 1. The voluntary guideline clarifies service scope for each channel, mandates clear human agent access points, scientific task division, and automatic escalation to human representatives when conditions are met. Though not legally binding, it serves as an industry benchmark to improve service quality. Businesses favor AI customer service because it reduces costs by over 70 percent; some exploit AI to exhaust consumer patience and increase withdrawal rates.
